address: 99 Mittraphap Road, Kham Muang, Khao Suan Kwang, Khon Kaen, 40280, Thailand
bio: Throw a stick in Khon Kaen and you’ll likely hit a street food place serving grilled chicken and Isan dishes. You’d be lucky if you landed on this one. Its secret is tender, juicy chicken from three local breeds. A second downtown branch offers the same menu minus grilled offal....
